vocaloid.target: every VocaDB Original voice-synth song with a resolved official Original YouTube PV, ordered by views
notes: VocaDB-only classification and metadata; official YouTube Data API view counts only.
SongType must equal Original and at least one enabled service=Youtube, pvType=Original upload must have an official API view count. There is no minimum-view threshold or row cap.
Generic OtherVoiceSynthesizer and VirtualSinger artist types do not establish voice-synth eligibility.
Producer/composer credit takes precedence over simultaneous human-vocalist roles, preventing instrumentalists from being promoted to main artist.
Official YouTube statistics and the exhaustive VocaDB scan are checkpointed; a quota-limited rerun resumes with unresolved IDs instead of repeating the full lookup.
No Spotify matching, title collision matching, remix, mashup, cover, remaster, MusicPV entry, reprint, or third-party view-count fallback.
preserved_original_pv_rows=215553; vocadb_exhaustive=True; unresolved_youtube_video_ids=6735

kpop.target: all official videos above 100,000,000 views found by the fully scanned catalog/curation-backed K-pop artist registry
notes: Catalog rows require an exact cleaned K-pop genre plus Korean ISRC, Korean source-country metadata, or Korean artist identity.
YouTube discovery accepts only parsed artists in the audited catalog/curation-backed artist registry; generic Western-pop results are rejected.
Artist aliases and Korean/Latin title variants are canonicalized before deduplication.
Every retained row has an observed YouTube view count strictly above 100,000,000.
Successful artist searches and video-statistics snapshots are checkpointed; a quota-limited rerun resumes at the first unfinished artist and preserves verified rows.
trusted_artists=59; preserved_rows=270; catalog_qualified=60; live_youtube_qualified=258; final_deduplicated_rows=275
Completeness is scoped to the fully scanned audited artist registry; it is not a claim that every upload labeled K-pop on the internet has been enumerated.

countries.target: 1,000 per detected Spotify regional market (76 detected this run)
notes: Source index advertised 76 country/territory markets: 73 contain 1000 ranked unique songs; 2 historical totals pages are source-exhausted below the requested target.
